theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  simp only [ne_eq, ← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at hPP hPS
  have hc := (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq (s := P) hPP).mp fun Q hQ hPQ =>
    Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ fun A hA =>
      Classical.byContradiction fun h => hPS ⟨A, h, fun B hB => hQ hA (hPQ hB)⟩
  rwa [Fintype.card_set, ← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Fintype.card_pos (α := S)),
    pow_succ', Nat.mul_left_cancel_iff Nat.two_pos] at hc
